While “non-lesional” is accurate descriptively, the clinical-electrographic constellation is so characteristic that the diagnosis is not merely “focal onset impaired awareness seizures” — it is specifically *mesial temporal lobe epilepsy*, the most common adult-onset focal epilepsy syndrome. The term “non-lesional” reflects imaging sensitivity limits, not diagnostic uncertainty.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Mesial temporal lobe epilepsy
